name: Smoky Tofu Kebabs
ingredients: 250 g firm tofu, grated or mashed
1 green chilli and 1 tsp ginger, minced
½ tsp each cumin and garam masala
steps: Squeeze the tofu in a clean cloth to remove water.
Mix with the chickpeas, besan, onion, chilli, ginger, spices, coriander and salt. Rest for 10 minutes.
Cook in a non-stick pan with the oil for 3–4 minutes per side until browned and firm.
Serve with mint chutney and sliced onion.
note: Smoked paprika stands in for tandoor smokiness; chickpeas and besan bind the mixture.
